text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce contest, Transcend seized 
the crown of the Champions Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having obtained data on Espoir City, 
Transcend now seeks a battle with Furioso 
and Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In today's race, she may have caught a 
brief glimpse of the thrilling sensation 
she was seeking. She wants the data, but 
more than that, she says she wants to run 
alongside the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next race was set: the GⅠ 
February Stakes, where she could test 
herself against formidable rivals!
